name: Bill Hagerty

pages.title: Bill Hagerty for U.S. Senate
pages.text:
## Join Team Hagerty
Join thousands of grassroots conservative patriots on Team Hagerty by signing up to receive critical campaign updates. You can also contact us by emailing info@teamhagerty.com.
## Delivering Conservative Results for Tennessee
Bill Hagerty is President Trump’s top ally in the Senate, and he delivers big wins for the Volunteer State
## Stand with Bill Hagerty
The radical left would love nothing more than to silence Bill Hagerty. We are counting on patriots like you to chip in to help fight back.
